name: NVIDIA
basis: each funding- or dividend-inclusive history is scaled to its own latest raw USD close

fundingForecast.displaySign: positive is earned by a perp long; negative is paid by a perp long

onchainSpot.preferenceBasis: all pages display separate CEX reported-volume and contract-backed DEX execution sections
onchainSpot.volumeSource: direct Binance, Bitget, Bybit, OKX, and Meteora venue APIs plus factory-verified PancakeSwap V3 pool-event volume indexed by DexScreener; DEX quote routes without indexed pool-event volume are excluded
onchainSpot.liquiditySource: direct CEX order books; direct Ethereum, Robinhood-chain, and PancakeSwap V3 quoter depth; direct Meteora pool state; and direct Jupiter executable round-trip quotes

peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: AMD 24.0% with 3/3 replicate support; XYZ100 24.0% with 3/3 replicate support; SKHX 15.3% with 3/3 replicate support; MSFT 14.0% with 3/3 replicate support; MU 9.3% with 2/3 replicate support; AMZN 6.7% with 2/3 replicate support; GOOGL 6.7% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Advanced Micro Devices
peers.reason: AMD is the closest direct substitute in the universe because it sells GPUs and AI accelerators into the same data-center training and inference demand that drives NVDA, making share shifts and accelerator-cycle pricing common economic drivers.

peers.name: Nasdaq-100
peers.reason: The Nasdaq-100 is also a return peer because NVDA is a large constituent and the index captures a major share of the stock's mega-cap growth and technology systematic return, rather than serving only as an anonymous high-beta reference. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 112.11 USD millions, supporting execution.

peers.name: SK hynix common
peers.reason: SK hynix common is a critical HBM and DRAM supplier into NVIDIA AI accelerators, so memory pricing, HBM qualification, and supply capacity are shared input-cost and shipment channels for NVDA. The common line is preferred to the SK hynix ADR because it is the direct underlying and shows 104.714 USD millions of displayed 24-hour perp liquidity versus 32.365 USD millions for the ADR.

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.reason: Microsoft is a major customer through Azure AI infrastructure and a leading source of accelerator capital spending. Changes in its AI cloud demand and capex plans feed directly into expectations for NVDA data-center revenue.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: Micron Technology is a core supplier of the high-bandwidth memory that ships inside NVIDIA's AI systems, so its revenue and margin cycle is tightly linked to NVIDIA's unit volumes and platform transitions. This shared input-cost and supply-chain exposure makes it a first-order return comparator, and its 59.489 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity supports the weight.

peers.name: Amazon
peers.reason: Amazon is a major NVIDIA customer through AWS and also develops its own Trainium silicon, so it shares the same cloud AI capex driver while representing the in-house substitution risk that shapes NVIDIA's pricing power.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.reason: Alphabet is both a top buyer of NVIDIA GPUs for Google Cloud and DeepMind and a partial rival through its TPU program, tying its returns to the same AI compute spending wave that powers NVIDIA's data-center segment.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: Nasdaq-100 is the cleanest primary hedge because NVDA is a very large constituent and the index captures the dominant systematic mega-cap technology and AI-leadership beta in NVDA returns. It is preferred over semiconductor leveraged or theme wrappers because it hedges broad equity risk without adding leverage or a narrower memory-only exposure.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

earningsOptions.source: Schwab listed-options chain, FMP earnings calendars, and Sharadar adjusted prices

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with FMP historical calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
